verdicts.reason: A: the headline almost touches the 'Order a Case' button, with only a few pixels between them. The legal line is set nearly as large as the subhead, so the hierarchy is flat. The Q logo has shrunk to an unreadable dot in the bottom-left corner. The card is jammed against the top and right edges, leaving a large dead area below the text. B has all the same flaws and is worse: the headline actually runs into the button's left edge, and the card is pushed so far left that it crowds the bottle. The bottle and the confetti are squeezed into a narrow strip.
